page.overview:
What is So What?

So What? is the eleventh track from 1998's album Garage, Inc. second disc. It was written by Nick Kulmer, Chris Exall, and Clive Blake, with a length of 3:09.

Originally released by The Anti-Nowhere League in 1981 as a B-side to the Streets of London single, Metallica have already released their version in their 1991's The Unforgiven single. It also features in the Sad But True single; and as a live version in Mama Said single (recorded on 1996 in Irvine, CA) and The 30th Anniversary Celebration single (recorded on 2011 in San Francisco, CA).

Well I've been to Hastings And I've been to Brightin I've been to Eastbourne too So what? So what? And I've been here I've been there I've been every fucking where So what? So what? So what? So what, you boring little c***?

Who cares? Who cares what you do? Yeah, who cares? Who cares about you, you, you, you, you?
